text: Algorithm 1 Gradient Descent 1: Given: Dataset (X, T) 2: Given: Network model net with parameters © 3: Given: Loss function Cost 4: Given: Learning rate x 5: for epochs do 6: y < net(X) > (Forward pass) 7: loss + Cost(y,T) > (Evaluate loss) 8: loss.zero_grad() > (Set all gradients to zero) 9: loss.backward () > (Backpropagation) 10: © + O — kO.grad > (Gradient update) 11: end for
